summary: Today’s visible crypto sentiment is cautiously bullish on select altcoins, with several traders still favoring momentum names and AI-related tokens while waiting for clearer BTC direction. The strongest fresh read from the available material is a pro-altcoin bias around HYPE, TAO, and broader swing-trade setups, while BTC remains the market pivot and macro assets are not covered well in the available results.
